# Dotan Veretzky

> Personal portfolio of Dotan Veretzky, a software engineer, game developer, web and AI developer based in Israel. The site can be read as a clean portfolio or walked through as a 3D coastal city.

## About

- [Dotan Veretzky](https://dotanv.vercel.app/): software engineer, game developer, web and AI developer.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dotan-v/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DotanVG)
- [Personal site](https://dotanv.vercel.app/)
- [itch.io](https://dotanv.itch.io/)

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://dotanv.vercel.app/): about, selected projects, experience, education, and contact.
- [About](https://dotanv.vercel.app/#about)
- [Projects](https://dotanv.vercel.app/#projects)
- [Experience](https://dotanv.vercel.app/#experience)
- [Education](https://dotanv.vercel.app/#education)
- [Contact](https://dotanv.vercel.app/#contact)
- [Explore mode](https://dotanv.vercel.app/?mode=explore): walkable 3D city version of the same portfolio.

## Selected projects

- [BeatEmPie](https://beat-em-pie.vercel.app/): browser beat 'em up.
- [Orbital Breach](https://orbital-breach.vercel.app/): zero-gravity multiplayer shooter.
- [Count Dawn](https://count-dawn.vercel.app/): reverse horde survival game.
- [URL Metadata Fetcher](https://react-node-url-mdata-fetch-dotanv.netlify.app/): inspect Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD, and HTML metadata.
